note: LOCAL_FIRST posture: ODG ALWAYS runs the local deterministic pipeline (build → tests → patch → validation) and local recovery first; an AI provider is reached ONLY when local execution is PROVEN impossible (AutonomyRuntimeAdapter.runPipeline: local → recovery → provider only when recovery.exhausted && missionRequiresProvider). Target ≥95% of missions execute entirely locally. External providers stay registered/AVAILABLE for that last-resort case; set externalProvidersEnabled=false for a strict local-only posture — the seam then reports a precise policy-deny cause instead of calling.
